_template: Canonical harness.json. /harness-init copies this to .harness/harness.json and dev-ops fills every test_kinds.cmd by RUNNING it. See templates/README.md.
_panel_era_start_note: The date the adversarial plan panel (FEAT-45) became available in THIS project. INV-32 does not grade a plan signed before it, because a plan signed before the panel existed cannot carry a record of one. null means this project has no pre-panel era, so every approved plan is graded — the right value for a project onboarded after FEAT-45. check-state.sh is copied into every onboarded project, so this MUST be per-project: a hardcoded date would export one repository's history as another's gate (BUG-1071 panel finding F2).
_test_matrix_note: change_type -> required test kinds. A FLOOR, not a ceiling: qa may add kinds it infers from the diff, never drop below. Predicate names in `when` are FIXED DATA so the gate is auditable; qa evaluates them against the diff.
_test_kinds_note: EVERY cmd ships as null. dev-ops replaces it with a command it has RUN and seen pass, or leaves it null and REPLACES the placeholder _reason with the real one. NEVER write a plausible-looking command you have not executed: `node --test src/` reports `tests 1 / fail 1` for a module-load error, which reads exactly like a failing suite (DEC-98). A null cmd is a not-applicable soft skip in the qa gate; an invented cmd turns a hard gate into a silent no-op, which is strictly worse. DELETE the _reason on any kind whose cmd you fill — leaving 'unset, detection has not run' beside a verified command is a lie about the project's own config. `exclude` keeps worktree and vendor dirs out of diff scans — measured 3x test-file inflation in kaya-ai without it.

unit._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet

functional._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet

integration._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet

component._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet

ui._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet. If the project has no browser-driver, leave null: qa records `ui: skipped (no browser target)` and does NOT fail.

eval._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet. Required only for change_type: ai_behavior; ai-dev authors the eval, qa gates it.

typecheck._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet. Not in the matrix; available for qa to add.

_commit_attribution_note: Recovery derives what landed from `git log` rather than trusting a state file, and review scope depends on telling human edits from agent commits (SPEC 15.3).
_dirty_tree_note: A dirty tree halts a team with BLOCKED. Without this whitelist the harness's own run artifacts would deadlock the next run.

budgets._max_total_runs_rationale: INFORMATIONAL, NOT A GATE (issue #79). Cycles count REWORK only (DEC-157), so a first-pass run adds nothing and NOTHING bounded or even counted total runs — FEAT-03 ran 19 times against a 6-cycle count and tripped nothing. Cost was the other long-feature signal and DEC-178 deleted it, so this is the only one left. Set to 20 from measured data: across nine features the range is 1-19 runs (median 14), so this is a tripwire for the runaway, NOT a critique of normal work — a long feature is fine if each run is efficient, resolves issues and advances the SCs. Crossing it emits a NOTE naming those three questions; it never stops a branch. NOTE THE KNOWN UNDER-COUNT: a main-session-direct segment is not a run and never appears in runs:, which on FEAT-07 hid eight of ten tasks, so the count is a FLOOR.
budgets._max_total_cycles_rationale: REWORK loops only (DEC-157): a cycle is a FAIL routed back, an unmet-SC re-dispatch, or a lead-reported send-back — never a first-pass run, which the PLAN's task list already bounds. Ten consecutive rework loops on one feature is the runaway this kills. Per-feature raises are user decisions recorded in feature.json.
budgets._orchestrator_context_warn_tokens_ration: INFORMATIONAL, NOT A GATE: the orchestrator context size at which the harness ADVISES rather than refuses, a context token count and not money.

github._note: GitHub Issues mirror (DEC-138). sync is asked ONCE at /harness-init; repo is pinned there from `gh repo view` under the user's eyes and NEVER re-inferred per call. One-way outbound after plan approval; gh absent = skip-and-report, never a gate.
github._board_note: Project board for the station mirror (FEAT-18): owner, number, station_field, and stations — an ORDERED LIST of exactly the six lowercase names backlog, plan, ready, building, review, done. THE SIX ARE FIXED AND MAY NOT BE RENAMED, REORDERED OR EXTENDED (FEAT-41 T-01); factory_config.MANDATED_STATIONS is the mandate the declaration is checked against, so the list is a checksum rather than a place to choose names. The board's column names are DERIVED from the six by factory_config.station_column(), the one place a capitalised station name is produced, so store no capitals here. Extra columns you add to the board yourself are untouched by the harness. Everything resolves by name at runtime, never by a pinned id. null = this project has no board and no station is ever written. A board that is present but incomplete is a loud error naming the offending key, never a silently disabled feature.
